reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 23 May deadline because there's nothing on Thornbury Cloth Co. to check it against. #central-team doesn't mention them, the shared account files are empty, and a keyword search of the workspace brain found nothing.

In the reply I said the claim is still unverified and that I haven't saved it as a deadline. I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed this year, so they may mean 23 May 2027, or it may have been misheard. I suggested that whoever owns the account get the date in writing from Thornbury. No finance figures or direct-message content came up, so I didn't need anyone's approval.
